issues.description: The UML and problem text indicate messageOnFeed() as a public abstract method (UML shows '+ messageOnFeed():String'), but the solution declares it as 'protected abstract String messageOnFeed()' in Animal.java. This visibility mismatch could confuse students about the intended visibility and the expected accessibility of the method across classes.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the solution to declare the method as public (public abstract String messageOnFeed();) to match the UML and text, or update the UML/problem statement to explicitly show/provide 'protected' visibility for messageOnFeed(). Preferably declare it public in Animal to match the UML and typical expectations.
